\chapter{The First Form Line: Name}
\label{ch:hi-a1-name-field}
\hlchaptermodality{67}

\begin{chapteropening}
\textbf{By the end of this chapter:} \emph{I can recognise the Hindi name label and fill one requested name line from a nonverbal cue without a model.}

Complete HI-A1F01-name-no-model and fill one Hindi name field from a nonverbal identity cue after separate label, selection, supported-entry, delayed-entry, spelling, spacing, and repair passes.
\end{chapteropening}

\section[nām]{\hi{नाम} — the first A1 form label}

\label{lesson:HI-A1F01-name-label}



\begin{quote}
Read the known word \textbf{\hi{नाम}}. Say what it means, then write it once from the word you already know.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know first — read the label}
\begin{quote}
\textbf{\hi{नाम}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

On a form, \textbf{\hi{नाम}} asks for a name. The colon belongs to the form; it is not a Devanagari letter. Point to the label, then point to the empty answer line.

\subsection*{Writing — one bounded copy}
Copy only \textbf{\hi{नाम}} once. Check \textbf{\hi{न}}, then \textbf{\hi{ा}}, then \textbf{\hi{म}}, and draw each head-line after its letter shape. Do not add a value yet. This visible copy is supported script practice, not independent form writing.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Find \textbf{\hi{नाम}} among \textbf{\hi{काम} · \hi{नाम} · \hi{दाम}} without writing the other words.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[A Mīrā; B Aruṇ]{Two people, two known practice names}

\label{lesson:HI-A1F01-name-select}



\begin{quote}
Read both names from the earlier sentence work:

\begin{quote}
\textbf{\hi{मीरा} · \hi{अरुण}}
\end{quote}
\end{quote}

\subsection*{The two words — attach one nonverbal cue to each person}
For this closed practice bank only:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \textbf{A $\to$ \hi{मीरा}}
  \item \textbf{B $\to$ \hi{अरुण}}
\end{itemize}

Look for five seconds. Cover the Devanagari names. Point to A and recall its name; point to B and recall its name. Uncover and compare.

\subsection*{Your turn — select, do not copy}
With the bank visible, choose the value requested by B, then the value requested by A. Do not write either one. This pass separates selection from spelling.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after the two-way contrast. No third name enters this field bank.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[nām: Mīrā]{Fill one field with the bank visible}

\label{lesson:HI-A1F01-name-supported}



\begin{quote}
Read the label \textbf{\hi{नाम}}. Recall the visible bank: \textbf{A \hi{मीरा} · B \hi{अरुण}}.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn — supported entry}
Keep the bank visible. Card A requests its known value:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\hi{नाम}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Select \textbf{\hi{मीरा}} and copy it on the line. Read the completed field from label to value. This is supported entry, not independent writing evidence.

\subsection*{Writing — separate spelling and placement passes}
First check only spelling: \textbf{\hi{मी} | \hi{रा}}. Then check one ordinary space after the colon. If one dimension differs, repair that dimension and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Stop after one supported field.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[B cue: Aruṇ]{Hide the bank, then fill one line}

\label{lesson:HI-A1F01-name-delayed}



\begin{quote}
Look once: \textbf{A \hi{मीरा} · B \hi{अरुण}}. Cover the complete bank and wait ten seconds.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — delayed requested entry}
Keep the bank hidden. Complete only this field:

\begin{quote}
B — \textbf{\hi{नाम}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

The requested value comes from memory; there is no copyable answer beside the line. Reveal the bank only after writing.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
Compare in order: (1) requested person, (2) four written positions, (3) vowel marks and headline, (4) spacing after the colon. Repair the first differing dimension and stop.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This is one delayed choice, not the published six-field A1 form.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\hi{नाम}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_]{One no-model Hindi name field}

\label{lesson:HI-A1F01-name-no-model}



\begin{quote}
Close the preceding lessons. Keep only the two learned identity symbols in memory. There is no Devanagari value bank, support-language name, romanization, or completed model below.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Writing — independent controlled choice}
Complete the requested field:

\begin{quote}
A — \textbf{\hi{नाम}: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_}
\end{quote}

Choose the known value attached to A and write it from memory. Do not open an earlier lesson until the attempt is complete.

\subsection*{Your turn — separate repair passes}
After writing, compare in four bounded passes: requested person, spelling, vowel marks/headline, then label-value placement. Repair only the first differing dimension.

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This completes one field pattern. Five field families remain before the published six-to-eight-item A1 practical-form task can be attempted. This one-field checkpoint is untimed and does not claim full A1 readiness.
\end{tcolorbox}
